passages.scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
passages.text: The objective of this scheme is to facilitate self-employment for persons with disabilities who are currently unemployed. Under this scheme, a Financial Assistance is provided to the disabled person to encourage self-employment, small scale business and/or an Agro based project
